shots.vo: Baby Krishna steals butter while Yashoda watches.
shots.prompt: inside a mud-walled village kitchen in Gokul at dawn, baby Krishna sits on the floor beside a tipped clay pot, his hands full of white butter, butter on his cheeks, while his mother Yashoda in a red cotton saree stands in the doorway, hands on hips, smiling, warm sunlight through a small window, clay pots and a churning rod

shots.vo: Vishnu rests on the serpent Shesha.
shots.prompt: Lord Vishnu reclining on the coils of a giant white serpent Shesha, five cobra heads with spread hoods growing from the serpent's one thick body and rising in an arch above Vishnu like a canopy, divinely beautiful blue-skinned god, gold crown, yellow dhoti, one hand resting on his side, centre, calm ocean at night with stars, soft golden light, wide shot

Lord Hanuman holding an entire green mountain covered in glowing herbs flat on his raised palms high above his head, mountain clearly separate from his body, monkey god with reddish fur, gold crown, long tail, flying centre with arms stretched straight up, night sky with stars and dark clouds, moonlight, wide shot

Lord Shiva sits cross-legged in deep meditation on a snow-covered ledge of Mount Kailash, a cobra around his neck, the crescent moon in his matted hair, a trident planted beside him, mist and first light over the Himalayan peaks

why.2: Shesha's cobra heads float detached in the sky and aren't attached to the serpent body. The white coil is a blob with no real hoods rising over Vishnu.
why.3: Hanuman is merged into the mountain, with his face and limbs sticking out of the rock. He isn't flying and lifting the mountain on his palm.
